innovations.name: Energy
innovations.what: Rotation check. Oracle's Project Jupiter cleared a step: on Oct 26 a New Mexico hearing officer refused to dismiss its air permit application, after an Oct 14 redesign that cuts emissions about 35% and uses 1,600 MW of Bloom fuel cells instead of the 2,462 MW allocated (Santa Fe New Mexican). The state decision is due Nov 23 but may slip to Dec 18, with a public hearing from Dec 7. Dates set: NuScale Nov 5, Oklo Nov 6 and Fervo Nov 9 report Q3; the TAE and Trump Media vote is listed for Dec 14. No stage moves.
innovations.for_you: No action. BE is left out of both lists: the permit moved forward, but a smaller fuel cell count at Jupiter means less of the order than first planned. BE (203.17), OKLO (25.25) and SMR (5.62) are all Avoid on Oct 30 closes; no puts on them into their reports.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Brazil's stock market is shut Monday Nov 2 for All Souls' Day, so Brazilian shares cannot react at home to the weekend until Tuesday, though EWZ and the ADRs trade in New York (Rio Times, Nov 1). Forecasts for Wednesday's Copom split: the central bank's Focus survey median still points to a 0.25 point cut to 13.50%, while Polymarket now gives 81.2% to a hold at 13.75%, up from 78.4% (Rio Times). It is still not known whether the government will publish a spending plan before the meeting.
countries.for_you: No Brazil buys, swings or new puts before Wednesday's decision. Expect EWZ and the ADRs to carry Monday's move alone, which can mean a wider gap on Tuesday in Sao Paulo. Left out of both lists: a cut helps borrowers, but a cut while the real is weak could hurt the currency.

countries.name: China
countries.what: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, below the 50.0 Reuters poll, and the non manufacturing PMI fell to 49.7 from 50.2 (NBS, Oct 31). Small firms were weakest at 47.5 while high tech manufacturing stayed at 51.3. The statistics bureau blamed demand pulled forward before the National Day holiday and a complex world backdrop.
countries.for_you: No action. Weak factory and service demand is bad for China consumer names (BABA, PDD), which are not on the buy zone list.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: OPEC+ kept December output targets unchanged at its Nov 1 meeting, and most Gulf members still pump below their targets (Bloomberg, CNBC). Trump said Oct 31 the US is in no hurry to strike again, Rubio said no decision is made, and Fox reported strikes are unlikely before the Nov 3 vote. Iran's foreign minister said a plan with Qatar could reopen Hormuz within two days if the US meets Tehran's terms, and said Iran has no plan to meet US officials now, which undercuts Saturday's report of direct talks (AP via Fox, Tribune). Saudi air defenses downed a drone near Riyadh on Oct 31, and CENTCOM said it has redirected 144 ships under the blockade.
countries.for_you: Swing: no new oil trades before Wednesday; take the plan on XOM and CVX. DAL is now 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' (lower highs and lower lows); no buy or put. Left out of both lists: the weekend added both a deal path and a strike path.
